Rating

Ratings let users view or select a score. Star icons support full and half values, sizes, labels, counts, and alternative symbols like hearts or thumbs.

Basic Rating

Build with .zak-rating and .zak-rating-star. Use zak-rating-star-filled for active stars.

HTML
<div class="zak-rating">
  <span class="zak-rating-star zak-rating-star-filled">
    <svg class="zak-icon">...</svg>
  </span>
  <span class="zak-rating-star">
    <svg class="zak-icon">...</svg>
  </span>
</div>

Half Stars

Use zak-rating-star-half to render a partial star (overlay clip).

4.5 out of 5

HTML
<span class="zak-rating-star zak-rating-star-half">
  <svg class="zak-icon">...</svg>
</span>

Rating with Count and Label

Append a rating count and optional label text.

5.0 · 327 reviews
HTML
<div class="zak-rating">... stars ...</div>
<span class="zak-rating-label">5.0 · 327 reviews</span>

Read-Only Rating

Same markup, no interactive roles — perfect for review summaries.

4.0
HTML
<div class="zak-rating" aria-label="Rated 4 out of 5">
  <span class="zak-rating-star zak-rating-star-filled">...</span>
  <span class="zak-rating-star">...</span>
</div>

Rating Sizes

Scale with zak-rating-sm and zak-rating-lg, or bump the icon width/height inline.

HTML
<div class="zak-rating zak-rating-sm">...</div>
<div class="zak-rating">...</div>
<div class="zak-rating zak-rating-lg">
  <svg class="zak-icon" style="width: 2rem; height: 2rem;">...</svg>
</div>

Hearts and Thumbs

Swap the star icon for hearts or thumbs for different sentiment styles.

48 likes
1 of 5 helpful
HTML
<div class="zak-rating" style="--zak-rating-color: var(--zak-color-danger);">
  <span class="zak-rating-star zak-rating-star-filled">
    <svg class="zak-icon">...</svg> <!-- heart path -->
  </span>
</div>

Interactive Rating

Make stars clickable with a radio-group role. The demo below is wired via data-interactive-rating.

Click a star to rate
HTML
<div class="zak-rating" role="radiogroup" data-interactive-rating>
  <span class="zak-rating-star" role="radio" tabindex="0" data-value="1">...</span>
  <span class="zak-rating-star" role="radio" tabindex="-1" data-value="2">...</span>
</div>

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
document.querySelectorAll('[data-interactive-rating]').forEach(function (group) {
  var stars = Array.prototype.slice.call(group.querySelectorAll('[role="radio"]'));
  function paint(value) {
    stars.forEach(function (s, i) {
      s.classList.toggle('zak-rating-star-filled', i < value);
      s.setAttribute('tabindex', i === value - 1 ? '0' : '-1');
      s.setAttribute('aria-checked', i < value ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }
  stars.forEach(function (star) {
    star.addEventListener('click', function () {
      paint(Number(star.dataset.value));
    });
    star.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        var next = Math.min(5, Number(star.dataset.value) + 1);
        paint(next);
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        var prev = Math.max(1, Number(star.dataset.value) - 1);
        paint(prev);
      } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
        paint(1);
      } else if (e.key === 'End') {
        paint(5);
      }
    });
  });
});

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-ratingContainer — reads --zak-rating-color
.zak-rating-starSingle icon (outline by default)
.zak-rating-star-filledActive/filled icon
.zak-rating-star-halfHalf-filled icon
.zak-rating-sm / .zak-rating-lgSmall / large icon sizes
.zak-rating-labelText label (value + count)

Accessibility

  • Read-only ratings: keep the icon group aria-hidden and expose the numeric score as text.
  • Interactive ratings: use role="radiogroup"/role="radio" with aria-checked and keyboard support (arrows, Home/End).
  • Pair stars with a visible numeric label rather than relying on glyph alone.
  • Announce the selected value with a live region on change.
  • Don't use color alone to signal filled vs unfilled; the outline/fill contrast carries meaning.
